title: IPB Var DM1 Corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: IPB Var DM1 Corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: IPB Var DM1 corn is an open pollinated corn variety for Mindanao. About 106 days to harvest, 5.2 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: IPB Var DM1 corn is an open pollinated corn variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2021 as NSIC 2021 Cn 331. Cereals Section, Institute of Plant Breeding bred it. It takes about 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 5.25 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

IPB Var DM1 corn takes about 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is 3.8 days longer than the average of the 10 open pollinated corn varieties with a day count, 102.7 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 5.25 t/ha trails the average of its group, 5.67. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 15.19 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 77.77 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
Where and when to plant IPB Var DM1 corn

It is recommended for Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?

The record shows 5.25 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
Yes. It is open pollinated, so seed from a clean, isolated field grows true. Still, certified seed gives the best start every few seasons.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of IPB Var DM1?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
